mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 2000), rising home construction activity drives consumer wealth and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
